content:
{
    "version": 1,
    "schema_notes": "Catalog of curated 3D mesh + material packs. Each card's 'prompt' field is pre-filled into chat on click, the AI then guides the user through download, import, and optional material setup. Optional 'preview_image' field points to a local PNG/JPG under Resources/AssetPacks/previews/ (rendered as thumbnail). Optional 'download_url' is the direct HTTP link to the asset file/zip for automatic download via fetch + unreal import.",
    "default_import_folder": "/Game/LocoAI/Meshes",
    "sources": {
        "kenney": "https://kenney.nl/assets?filter=3d",
        "quixel": "https://www.fab.com/sellers/Quixel",
        "polyhaven": "https://polyhaven.com/models",
        "ambient_cg": "https://ambientcg.com/list",
        "ue_marketplace_free": "https://www.unrealengine.com/marketplace/en-US/free",
        "sketchfab_cc0": "https://sketchfab.com/features/free-3d-models?features=downloadable&licenses=322a749bcfa841b29dff1e8a1bb74b0b"
    },
    "categories": [
        {
            "id": "environment",
            "label": "Environment, props & kits",
            "icon_color": "#6b9f5a",
            "assets": [
                {
                    "name": "Kenney, Nature Kit",
                    "source": "Kenney.nl",
                    "license": "CC0",
                    "format": "FBX",
                    "asset_count": "~50 meshes",
                    "tags": ["kenney", "low-poly", "trees", "rocks", "nature", "CC0"],
                    "description": "50+ stylized low-poly nature assets (trees, bushes, rocks, flowers). Zero-attribution CC0. Great for prototyping outdoor scenes.",
                    "prompt": "Help me download Kenney's 'Nature Kit' and batch-import it into my project.\n\nSteps:\n1. Open https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit in a browser.\n2. Download the ZIP (CC0, no attribution required).\n3. Extract to a temp folder, contains FBX files under /Models/.\n4. Use execute_python with unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().import_asset_tasks() to batch import every .fbx in the folder into /Game/LocoAI/Meshes/NatureKit/.\n5. Apply a basic lit Master Material to each, OR use the PBR textures included in /Textures/.\n6. Report how many meshes were imported."
                },
                {
                    "name": "Kenney, Platformer Kit",
                    "source": "Kenney.nl",
                    "license": "CC0",
                    "format": "FBX",
                    "asset_count": "~60 meshes",
                    "tags": ["kenney", "platformer", "cubes", "low-poly", "CC0"],
                    "description": "Modular platformer blocks, stairs, ramps, cubes with different tops (grass, dirt, sand, snow). Snaps together for rapid level blockout.",
                    "prompt": "Help me download Kenney's 'Platformer Kit' pack and batch-import the meshes.\n\nSteps:\n1. https://kenney.nl/assets/platformer-kit, download ZIP.\n2. Extract locally.\n3. Batch import every .fbx under /Models/ into /Game/LocoAI/Meshes/PlatformerKit/.\n4. Each cube is ~1m so they snap to UE's default 100 grid.\n5. Report the imported assets."
                },
                {
                    "name": "Quixel Megascans (via Fab)",
                    "source": "Fab by Epic Games",
                    "license": "Free with Epic Games account (UE EULA)",
                    "format": "Megascans asset",
                    "asset_count": "10,000+ photoreal scans",
                    "tags": ["megascans", "photoreal", "quixel", "pbr"],
                    "description": "Massive photoreal library, rocks, debris, foliage, surfaces. Completely free with an Epic account since Quixel joined Epic.",
                    "prompt": "Walk me through using Fab (ex-Quixel Bridge) to add a photoreal asset to my project.\n\nSteps:\n1. Open Epic Games Launcher → Fab (or https://www.fab.com/) signed in with Epic account.\n2. Filter by 'Megascans' and 'Free'.\n3. Pick a sample asset, e.g., 'Moss Rock' or a ground surface.\n4. Click 'Add to My Library' then 'Send to Unreal Engine'.\n5. The asset lands under /Game/Megascans/ in my project.\n6. Confirm it's there and suggest a material I should apply."
                }
            ]
        },
        {
            "id": "props",
            "label": "Props, weapons / items / pickups",
            "icon_color": "#d9a458",
            "assets": [
                {
                    "name": "Kenney, Weapon Pack",
                    "source": "Kenney.nl",
                    "license": "CC0",
                    "format": "FBX",
                    "asset_count": "30+ weapons",
                    "tags": ["kenney", "weapons", "sword", "axe", "gun", "CC0"],
                    "description": "Melee + ranged weapons, swords, axes, shields, bows, guns. Low-poly, handled-proportioned.",
                    "prompt": "Download Kenney's weapon pack and import.\n\nSteps:\n1. https://kenney.nl/assets (search 'weapon'). Likely pack: 'Medieval Weapons Kit' or 'Guns'.\n2. Download ZIP.\n3. Extract.\n4. Batch import .fbx files into /Game/LocoAI/Meshes/Weapons/.\n5. Report which weapons imported and suggest how to attach one to my ThirdPersonCharacter's right hand via a SkeletalMeshSocket."
                },
                {
                    "name": "Kenney, Food Kit",
                    "source": "Kenney.nl",
                    "license": "CC0",
                    "format": "FBX",
                    "asset_count": "40 food items",
                    "tags": ["kenney", "food", "pickups", "consumable", "CC0"],
                    "description": "Cute food items, apples, bread, cheese, etc. Perfect for collectibles in survival/cooking games.",
                    "prompt": "Download Kenney's 'Food Kit' and set up one item (e.g. an apple) as a pickup using add_pickup_template.\n\nSteps:\n1. https://kenney.nl/assets/food-kit, download ZIP.\n2. Extract.\n3. Import apple.fbx into /Game/LocoAI/Meshes/Food/Apple.\n4. Create /Game/Blueprints/BP_Apple (Actor) using add_pickup_template with the apple mesh + a sphere collision + counter_variable='Apples' on BP_ThirdPersonCharacter.\n5. Confirm the pickup works in PIE."
                },
                {
                    "name": "PolyHaven Models",
                    "source": "PolyHaven.com",
                    "license": "CC0",
                    "format": "FBX / GLB",
                    "asset_count": "200+ high-quality",
                    "tags": ["polyhaven", "CC0", "photoreal", "pbr"],
                    "description": "Photoreal CC0 models with full PBR textures. Higher poly than Kenney but stunning quality.",
                    "prompt": "Guide me through downloading a PolyHaven model (e.g., a wooden chair or barrel) and importing with full PBR textures.\n\nSteps:\n1. Open https://polyhaven.com/models.\n2. Pick any CC0 model (they're all CC0).\n3. Download FBX + all textures (BaseColor, Normal, Roughness, Metallic, AO).\n4. Extract locally.\n5. Import the mesh to /Game/LocoAI/Meshes/PolyHaven/<name>.\n6. Import each texture as Texture2D, set correct compression settings (sRGB only on BaseColor, Masks for Roughness/Metallic/AO).\n7. Create a Material Instance from my project's base PBR material, wire the 5 textures.\n8. Assign the Material Instance to the mesh."
                }
            ]
        },
        {
            "id": "characters",
            "label": "Characters, skeletal meshes",
            "icon_color": "#c38fd9",
            "assets": [
                {
                    "name": "UE5 Manny & Quinn",
                    "source": "Epic (bundled in Third Person template)",
                    "license": "Free (UE EULA)",
                    "format": "Skeletal Mesh",
                    "asset_count": "2 characters",
                    "tags": ["mannequin", "ue5", "biped"],
                    "description": "Default UE5 mannequins (Manny + Quinn) with modular skeleton support. Already in your project if you used the ThirdPerson template.",
                    "prompt": "Check if /Game/Characters/Mannequins/Meshes/ already has Manny/Quinn (they come with the UE5 ThirdPerson template).\n\nIf yes: list the paths.\nIf no: tell me how to add the ThirdPerson feature pack from the New Project Settings."
                },
                {
                    "name": "Mixamo Free Characters",
                    "source": "Mixamo",
                    "license": "Free (Adobe account)",
                    "format": "FBX skeletal",
                    "asset_count": "~60 rigged characters",
                    "tags": ["mixamo", "character", "rigged"],
                    "description": "Rigged human characters, Y-Bot, X-Bot, plus 60+ stylized humans ready for animation retargeting.",
                    "prompt": "Help me grab a free rigged character from Mixamo and import it with auto-rigged skeleton.\n\nSteps:\n1. https://www.mixamo.com/ → sign in.\n2. Browse 'Characters' tab and pick one (e.g., Y-Bot, Mannequin, or a stylized human).\n3. Download: Format=FBX for Unreal, Pose=T-Pose, Skin=With Skin.\n4. Import the .fbx at /Game/LocoAI/Characters/Mixamo/<name>/.\n5. UE imports the SkeletalMesh + Skeleton.\n6. Set up an IK Retargeter from the Mixamo skeleton to UE5 Mannequin so I can reuse existing animations."
                }
            ]
        },
        {
            "id": "materials",
            "label": "Materials, PBR & surfaces",
            "icon_color": "#6ca0d8",
            "assets": [
                {
                    "name": "AmbientCG Free PBR",
                    "source": "AmbientCG.com",
                    "license": "CC0",
                    "format": "PBR textures (Albedo/Normal/Roughness/Metallic/AO)",
                    "asset_count": "1500+ surfaces",
                    "tags": ["ambientcg", "pbr", "CC0", "texture"],
                    "description": "Huge CC0 library of tiling PBR surfaces, wood, metal, stone, fabric, concrete, more. 1-4K resolution.",
                    "prompt": "Guide me through downloading a tiling PBR surface from AmbientCG and building a UE Material from it.\n\nSteps:\n1. Open https://ambientcg.com/list (or a specific URL I provide).\n2. Pick a surface (e.g., 'Wood028').\n3. Download the 1K ZIP.\n4. Extract, contains Color, Normal, Roughness, AO, Metalness (if applicable) at 1024x1024.\n5. Import each as Texture2D at /Game/LocoAI/Materials/<name>/.\n6. Set compression: Color=sRGB, Normal=TC_Normalmap, Roughness/AO/Metalness=TC_Masks (sRGB OFF).\n7. Create a Material /Game/LocoAI/Materials/M_<name> with BaseColor, Normal, Roughness, AO (+ Metallic if applicable) wired.\n8. Apply to a test plane and confirm it renders correctly."
                },
                {
                    "name": "PolyHaven Textures",
                    "source": "PolyHaven",
                    "license": "CC0",
                    "format": "PBR textures",
                    "asset_count": "800+ surfaces",
                    "tags": ["polyhaven", "pbr", "CC0", "photoreal"],
                    "description": "Premium CC0 tiling PBR textures at up to 16K. Photoreal quality, rivals paid libraries.",
                    "prompt": "Download a PBR texture set from PolyHaven and build a UE Material.\n\nSteps same as AmbientCG flow but use https://polyhaven.com/textures → filter CC0 → pick 2K resolution.\nImport into /Game/LocoAI/Materials/PolyHaven/<name>/ and wire into a new Material."
                }
            ]
        },
        {
            "id": "vehicles",
            "label": "Vehicles",
            "icon_color": "#d97757",
            "assets": [
                {
                    "name": "Kenney, Car Kit",
                    "source": "Kenney.nl",
                    "license": "CC0",
                    "format": "FBX",
                    "asset_count": "~12 vehicles",
                    "tags": ["kenney", "vehicle", "car", "CC0"],
                    "description": "Low-poly stylized cars, sedan, sports, truck, taxi. Modular wheels for rigging.",
                    "prompt": "Download Kenney's 'Car Kit' pack and import.\n\nSteps:\n1. https://kenney.nl/assets, search 'car'. Likely: 'Car Kit' or 'City Kit: Roads'.\n2. Download ZIP.\n3. Extract.\n4. Batch import .fbx into /Game/LocoAI/Meshes/Vehicles/.\n5. Optionally, guide me through wiring one into a WheeledVehiclePawn using the imported wheel meshes."
                }
            ]
        }
    ],
    "legal_notes": [
        "CC0 assets have no attribution requirement and can be used in commercial games.",
        "UE Marketplace free assets are governed by the UE EULA, free for use in UE projects.",
        "Quixel Megascans via Fab are free with an Epic Games account and covered under the UE EULA for use in UE projects.",
        "Mixamo character + animations require an Adobe account and usage is covered under Adobe's Mixamo terms (free for commercial and non-commercial).",
        "PolyHaven, AmbientCG, and Kenney are CC0, do whatever you want, attribution appreciated but not required.",
        "Always keep the license file with any downloaded asset to preserve provenance."
    ]
}
